digest.component_or_area: plan-review & code-review on-ramp documentation and CLI/MCP explain seam
propositions: Agents and contributors lack concise author-facing documentation on how to write a plan that passes the plan-review gate; existing material covers only gate mechanics or reviewer criteria, not author intent.
No author-facing on-ramp exists for the code-review gate (LLM-Review + Verified); AGENTS.md currently misdirects authors to the reviewer-facing criterion registry.
The rebar explain CLI and MCP explain_criterion tool must be extended to serve both reviewer criteria (existing) and author guides (new) via a shared registry lookup.
Two new prose on-ramp docs must be discoverable from CLI (rebar explain plan, rebar explain review) and linked from docs/README.md to satisfy the docs-index CI gate.
The explain_guide path must be unit-tested across all three surfaces (library, CLI, MCP) to handle unknown-name and missing-file cases.
